lead: I lead, manage and scale technical teams, improve software delivery and bring generative AI into development. 15+ years in the industry, from web development to running an engineering department.

focus.title: What I do
focus.intro: Where I add the most value, and what you can ask me about in the interview.

items.title: Leadership and teams.
items.text: I build and grow engineering teams: hiring, onboarding, mentoring and objective-based reviews, with autonomy and a healthy engineering culture.

items.title: Software delivery and quality.
items.text: Agile practices, quality standards, automated code review, CI/CD and metrics to deliver more value with fewer incidents.

items.title: Business and delivery.
items.text: I lead engineering departments or areas, with responsibility for financial results, the project portfolio, pre-sales, and relationships with clients and leadership.

items.title: AI applied to development.
items.text: I bring generative AI into teams' daily work in a practical, safe and responsible way, and build applications with LLMs, RAG and agents.

ai.title: Applied AI
ai.intro: Generative AI is changing how we build software. I have brought it into real teams, and I study it and use it in depth.

items.title: Adoption in development teams (VASS).
items.text: I co-led the adoption of generative AI across the development teams in my area, introducing new methods, tools and processes into real projects. The initiative increased team autonomy, accelerated delivery cycles and strengthened quality standards, with an estimated average improvement of 30% in the teams’ ability to deliver value.

items.title: Master's in AI Engineering (LIDR, 2026).
items.text: LLM applications, RAG and CAG, agents and agentic systems, and AI evaluation.

items.title: tick-tack-done.
items.text: My personal project: a task and productivity app with an MCP server, so AI agents can work with it. I build it with AI agents and a GitHub backlog workflow.

roles.title: Department Manager · Digital Experience (Open Source PHP)
items: Led the department with full ownership of organizational decisions and responsibility for its financial results, project portfolio and business opportunities.
Organized engineering teams of 15–20 people: structure, priorities and project assignments.
Together with other leaders, drove the adoption of generative AI across development teams: roughly 30% more delivered value.
Opened new clients through small initial projects that later grew into larger business.
Coordinated cross-departmental projects, aligning priorities, deadlines, dependencies and delivery.
Oversaw nationwide projects, such as the loyalty platform of one of the country's leading telecom operators.
roles.summary: Running the department: people, project portfolio and results.

roles.title: Team Lead / Tech Lead · Digital Experience (Open Source PHP)
items: Grew the department from 1 to 20 people: designed the hiring process and technical challenges, interviewed with Talent Acquisition and prepared onboarding.
Managed a portfolio of around 30 projects, including a web and mobile intranet for thousands of employees of a national supermarket chain.
Supported the team's growth through mentoring, one-to-ones and objective-based reviews: three team members were promoted to more senior roles.
Introduced agile practices, quality standards and automated code review, plus logging, monitoring and metrics that reduced incidents and improved how they were tracked.
Automated key delivery processes to deliver more value with higher quality.
Held financial responsibility for the department and led pre-sales through to proposal and estimation.
roles.summary: Technical leadership and building the team from scratch.

roles.title: Senior PHP Developer
items: I co-led the technical development of UNIR's in-house WordPress content platform for its websites in Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador and the United States.
We built the internal product from scratch as a dedicated team with high standards. I helped design it with performance, scalability and security in mind.

As the team grew from 4 to 10 across backend, frontend and UX/UI, I drove CI/CD and container adoption with GitLab CI/CD and Docker, giving teams more autonomy, improving quality and cutting delivery times by around 40%.
I worked as the link between development and Systems, Marketing, Content, SEO and Legal to align development with business goals.
I completed a Master's in DevOps and Cloud at UNIR to support this work.
roles.summary: The content platform behind the university's international websites.

roles.title: Senior Web Developer
items: I helped design the platform that generated and managed pharmacy websites, with integrated online stores and a shared pharmaceutical catalogue. It connected to an in-house core platform that provided online marketing services to pharmacy clients.
I built the platform core with the team: the control panel, data API, segmented email campaigns and a mobile app backend.
I led three junior developers through iterative delivery, code review and technical coaching.
I organised incident handling and preventive and corrective maintenance with Kanban, giving the whole company visibility and traceability.
I worked across several stacks: websites and online stores, microservices, APIs, mobile applications and relational and non-relational databases.
roles.summary: An online marketing SaaS platform for pharmacies.

roles.title: Web Developer → Senior PHP Developer
items: I built websites and web applications from scratch for leading companies in telecommunications, education and insurance.
The projects focused on online marketing and generating leads.
We used techniques such as retargeting and A/B testing to improve conversion.
I was promoted to Senior PHP Developer in my first year and went on to lead large web projects.
roles.summary: Websites and applications for online marketing and customer acquisition.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.intro: A few projects that show how I work.

items.title: Corporate intranet for thousands of employees
items.text: I led the end-to-end development of a web and mobile platform for a national supermarket chain. I was responsible for technical direction and overall project management, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, overseeing planning, costs and delivery commitments, and leading strategic decisions and client communication.

items.title: International content platform.
items.text: UNIR's in-house product powering its websites in six countries. We built it from scratch; as the team grew from 4 to 10 people, CI/CD and containers shortened delivery by around 40%.

items.title: Marketing SaaS for pharmacies.

items.title: Master's in AI Engineering
items.description: Applied engineering for building products with LLMs: CAG, RAG, agent orchestration and evaluation of AI solutions. I put this into practice in my own projects, including this site with its AI interview and tick-tack-done with its MCP server.

items.title: LIDR Ignite technical leadership program
items.description: I took the program while leading the Digital Experience team at VASS to bring more structure to my day-to-day work. It covers mentoring, one-to-ones, hiring and onboarding, high-performing teams, and conflict resolution.

items.title: Master's in DevOps and Cloud
items.description: I studied at UNIR while the content platform team grew from 4 to 10 people and we adopted CI/CD and Docker with GitLab. The program covers DevOps culture, cloud (AWS), infrastructure as code, application lifecycles, CI/CD, Docker, Puppet and Chef, and includes a final project.

items.title: Technical Engineering Degree in Computer Science (Management Information Systems)
items.description: This degree gave me my technical foundation in software engineering. After graduating, I started working as a web developer at Logiqo.

items.text: PHP (custom development and WordPress), Drupal, Laravel and Symfony. APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, web security, performance and systems integration. Recent personal projects use TypeScript, Python and FastAPI. AI brings us back to basics: the fundamentals have never mattered more.

items.text: AI Engineering · Generative AI · LLM Applications · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG) · AI Agents & Agentic Systems · AI-assisted Software Development · Prompt Engineering · AI Evaluation · AI Adoption & Governance. about.title: About me
items: I have moved from designing and building software to growing and leading development teams, without losing my curiosity about how things work and how to make them better. I like staying close to technology, connecting what the business needs with what we can realistically build, and creating environments where people have autonomy, grow and build good software.
Today I am especially interested in how AI is changing the way we build software, learn and work. I am looking for a new role where I can keep combining engineering and leadership.
about.quote: I started out as a web developer and, over the years, learned that good projects come from good teams.
